title: Support-request: bespoke calibration & quantization exception for customer model on FP8->INT8 path
creator: Evelyn Cho
description: Customer (AcmeHealth, support SC-98123) reports an accuracy regression after switching their private deployment to our FP8 quantization profile. They are requesting a supported path to request per-model exceptions so we can keep FP8 globally but force INT8 for specific problematic layers or submodules after running a bespoke calibration. The model is a fine-tuned LLaMA-style 70B variant (acme-pt-llama-70b-v2) with long-context medical prompts. Customer is sensitive to hallucinations in diagnostic outputs and wants a validated calibration run and documented exception applied to their private deployment.
reproduction_steps: Provisioned private runtime with FP8 default profile (profile: fp8_aggressive_v1)
Deployed acme-pt-llama-70b-v2 and ran evaluation harness A (medical_diag_v2 prompts) using Redwood SDK v0.38
Observed consistent hallucination spike on ~8 diagnostic prompts compared to baseline INT8 run from 2026-02-14
Ran our quick calibration tool (calibrator-lite) with customer sample set (5k sequences) and captured per-layer activation histograms
Verified customer-provided golden outputs and measured failure modes (score drop, increased hallucination tokens)
Customer requests a bespoke calibration and configuration change that pins some layers to INT8 while keeping FP8 elsewhere, plus an accuracy validation report
investigation_summary: Initial calibration shows large dynamic ranges in FFN output activations for medical tokens; FP8 mapping clips outliers causing degraded logits
Attention output projections have spiky activations on long-context inputs which are quantized suboptimally by fp8_aggressive_v1 kernel path
Per-channel scales for some kernels are unstable across calibration batches — suggests dataset shift vs. open-source baseline used to generate default profile
No infra-level incompatibility detected (KV cache, sequence length handling fine). Issue appears statistical and per-layer, not a serving bug
Customer provided examples where forcing INT8 on specific FFN layers restores parity with their validation set
calibration_runs: run-2026-03-11-01: fp8_aggressive_v1, calibrator-lite, 5k sequences, per-tensor scales; observed MSE on logits +12.6% vs INT8 baseline
run-2026-03-11-02: fp8_aggressive_v1 + outlier-clamp=3.5, per-channel scales; MSE improved to +6.1% but still fails 3/120 critical prompts

run-2026-03-12-01: bespoke cal v1 (per-layer exception candidate): force-int8 on FFN layers 10,20,33; rest FP8; calibrator-full, 10k sequences; measured perplexity delta -0.2% vs INT8 full baseline and hallucination token rate within SLA

run-2026-03-13-01: validation run using customer golden outputs: bespoke config passes customer threshold on 118/120 prompts; remaining two prompts show minor token-level differences that customer deems acceptable
decision_log: 2026-03-12: Agreed with Support and Customer to allow per-model quantization exception manifest with explicit layer list and reason; implementation to be gated behind a feature flag in private deployments

2026-03-13: Engineering proposal accepted: add 'quant_exceptions' block to model deployment config schema that supports 'layer_pattern' and 'force_quant_type' (values: INT8|FP8) and a required 'calibration_report' link
2026-03-13: Safety: exceptions are disabled for hosted customers by default; Private/Dedicated customers may enable via support workflow with audit log entry
acceptance_criteria: Config schema change implemented and validated: 'quant_exceptions' accepted by private control plane and runtime
End-to-end calibration pipeline supports bespoke runs and outputs a stable 'calibration_report' artifact (JSON + SVG histograms) linked in deployment
Automated validation harness reproduces customer sample set results and reports parity (<=0.5% perplexity delta OR passes customer-defined prompt checks)
Support process documented: required artifacts, SLA expectations, and security checklist for exception approval
Unit + integration tests for forced-int8 code path and fallback behavior added to runtime test suite
next_steps: (Miguel) Spike: implement config parsing for 'quant_exceptions' and wire into serving runtime (ETA 3 days)
(Evelyn) Produce a template calibration_report and validation harness for support to run (ETA 2 days)
(Support) Obtain signed acceptance from AcmeHealth after bespoke run and upload calibration artifacts to Drive
(Security) Perform a light review of audit logging for exceptions before feature-flag flip (requested)
(QA) Add regression tests covering mixed FP8/INT8 runtime execution and quant_exceptions enforcement
